name: Artistic Display Stand
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    Crafted from premium 5mm thick wood or 5mm clear acrylic, this display stand ensures both durability and aesthetic appeal. The natural wood grain or the sleek acrylic finish makes it a perfect addition to any desk, dresser, or event table.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    6 × 6 inches ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
    8 × 8 inches ~ 20.32 × 20.32 cm
    10 × 10 inches ~ 25.4 × 25.4 cm
    Note: The number and placement of slots are flexible and can be customized to suit your design needs, while still fitting within the safe zone of each base size.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    The product features double-sided UV printing, ensuring vibrant, high-resolution graphics that are both long-lasting and fade-resistant. Every detail, from names to illustrations, is printed with clarity and precision.

 

  • Functionality Use:
    This versatile stand can be used for various decorative or functional purposes. Whether it's part of a themed setup, a custom nameplate, a tabletop display, or just a unique decorative item, it adds a personalized touch to any space. Its freestanding design makes it easy to place anywhere—from desks and shelves to reception areas and event tables.

 

  • Ideal Gift for All Occasions:
    Perfect as a meaningful keepsake or creative gift for weddings, anniversaries, engagements, birthdays, Valentine’s Day, Mother's Day, or as a thoughtful thank-you or housewarming. The option to personalize names, dates, or graphics makes it a sentimental and unique keepsake for anyone.

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
